XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Abnormal battery consumption and flashing odometer
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | B1000 | B1009 | B1021 | B1090 | B1091 | B10AA | U0019 | U0426 | U1411 | U1733 | CONTROL UNIT | BLUETOOTH | BATTERY | DISCHARGE | SPEEDOMETER | KILOMETRES | KM | VELOCEMENT | ALIGNMENT | NETWORK | PROXY | FLASHES |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Cars fitted with a Bluetooth system

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: Bluetooth control unit

  • Fault: Abnormal battery drain and odometer on the instrument panel flashing

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • B1000 (Instrument cluster control unit, instrument cluster – Fault)
    • B1009 (Battery voltage – Alternator / battery)
    • B1021 (Rear position lights / right-hand side – Wiring fault)
    • B1090 (Headlamp connection – Fault)
    • B1091 (Courtesy light – Fault)
    • B10AA (Proxy alignment check)
    • U0019 (CAN data bus, low speed – Communication fault)
    • U0426 (Auxiliary heater control module – Invalid data received)
    • U1411 (IBS – Intelligent Battery Sensor)
    • U1733 (No communication with Audio/Bluetooth control unit)
  • Cause: Faulty Bluetooth control unit

• Action: Check that the Bluetooth control unit is working properly and, if necessary, reset and/or replace it. Then perform proxy/network alignment using a diagnostic tool.
